###### Departments

![Image Production](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/1e8eff5a-84d0-4662-9177-6c8846447e45/web/produccion-1.jpg)

Production

Lights, camera, action! This is where they develop the ideas for the videos we record and plan their execution. They generally lead the recordings and also operate equipment such as microphones, cameras, tripods, and lights.

![Image Editing](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/9113a0d9-65dc-4f17-86b8-eabd1c13319e/web/edicion-1.jpg)

Edition

Time to make it happen! This department brings together the recorded footage into complete, entertaining, and original videos. They're experts at using editing software and know all the tricks for creating coherent narratives around different themes.

![Image Marketing](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/5ab0a9ac-338b-447d-9d82-aa5f4c4313c3/web/producciones-tvu-mercadeo.jpg)

Marketing

Let's show what we do! They are the ones who promote the group, the videos, and other content they create related to audiovisual topics. They manage the different social media platforms and handle all the outreach strategies.

![Image Human Resources Management](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/282556b4-9641-40f2-89aa-ee505860c547/web/gestion-humana-2.jpg)

Human Resources

They are responsible for maintaining group cohesion and fostering a positive work environment, and above all, a friendly atmosphere. They organize team-building activities and ensure we always have a good time.

###### Us

Since 1991, we have been a family passionate about storytelling and showcasing the reality of our university through film. We love what we do and are convinced that TVU Productions has become one of the best opportunities to gain experience in the audiovisual field, strengthen leadership and teamwork skills, and, of course, forge lifelong friendships. Together, we form a diverse and creative team that informs and entertains, while enjoying every shared experience.
